'''Pokémon Go!''', also known as '''Go Pokémon Go''', is an English song used in the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It was first used as the opening and ending theme for the special ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]'', and was later used as the ending theme of the English dub of [[S09|Pokémon: Battle Frontier]], which encompasses the episodes from ''[[AG146|Fear Factor Phony]]'' to ''[[AG192|Home is Where the Start Is!]]''.

The original airing of the English dub and the Japanese version of ''The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon'' use the rap portion of the song as both the opening and ending, while the English redub changes the opening to use a different part of the song. A shortened version of the rap portion was used as the ending for Battle Frontier, making it the only original ending theme to be used in the English dub of {{aniseries|PtS}}, as otherwise ending themes for the English dub have been shortened or instrumental versions of the opening themes.

The full version is available on the {{CD|Pokémon X}} CD, and was also featured in the music video in the [[10th Anniversary Perdue Farms promotion]].

==Credits==
* Performed by Atsushi "Toya" Tokuya
* Written by [[Akira Chiba]], Lawrence Neves, and Atsushi "Toya" Tokuya

==Trivia==
* This is the only English [[dub]] theme to be used in the original Japanese version.
* The {{pmin|France|French}} and the {{pmin|South Asia|Indian Disney XD Hindi/Tamil/Telugu}} dubs used an instrumental version of the track as the ending for [[S09|Battle Frontier]], rather than a dubbed version or the English version.

===Errors===
[[File:EDE04 error.png|thumb|200px|The typos]]
* [[TV Tokyo]] is [[List of typos|misspelled]] as ''TV Tok'''o'''yo''.
** Additionally, from ''[[AG146|Fear Factor Phony]]'' to ''[[AG157|Time Warp Heals All Wounds]]'', [[The Pokémon Company]] is misspelled as ''The Pok'''e'''mon Company'', lacking the accent over the "e".
